title: Introspective subjectivity is real, intrinsic subjectivity may be a fiction

statements.text: Introspective subjectivity is introspective awareness of experiences generated by representational mechanisms, and illusionists accept it while holding it radically misleading. Intrinsic subjectivity, a subjective dimension arising simply from being the things we are, is what taking phenomenal consciousness as a datum requires. It is deeply mysterious, and there is reason to explore the idea that introspective subjectivity creates it as a fiction.

sources.quote: We might call this introspective subjectivity.
Intrinsic subjectivity is, however, deeply mysterious.
